pill.desc: clear, colorless to slightly yellow-brown solution in a single-dose vial

tell: A modified gamma cyclodextrin that binds the blocker itself rather than the receptor, and leaves the body unchanged in urine.

clues.text: It binds neither plasma proteins nor erythrocytes, and about 96% of the dose leaves the body in urine, mostly unchanged.
The sodium salt of a modified gamma cyclodextrin, with a molecular weight of 2178.01. It is a sterile aqueous solution.
Approved under an NDA as single-dose vials of 200 mg/2 mL and 500 mg/5 mL, each at 100 mg/mL, given as one bolus injection.
No boxed warning; contraindicated in known hypersensitivity to the drug or its components. Pain and vomiting are among the most frequent adverse reactions in pediatric patients.
Reversal of neuromuscular blockade induced by rocuronium or vecuronium in adult and pediatric patients undergoing surgery.
Forms a complex with rocuronium and vecuronium, reducing the amount of blocker free to bind nicotinic receptors at the neuromuscular junction.
The generic name begins with S and has ten letters.
